# Neuromatter
## Overview
India's best B2B Neuromarketing company, helping brands improve Ad conversions using behavioral science.


## Core Services
- Conversion Diagnostics (Video / Creative / Packaging)
- Conversion Architecture (Pricing Pages / Landing Pages / Product Pages / Highest drop-off pages)
- Market Command (Product Launch / Multi-asset Launch / turn-around of low-performing SKUs)

## Methodology
Neuromatter pinpoints precise cognitive friction points across ads, creatives, and end-to-end UX journeys with the help of medical-grade EEG devices with expert neuropsychological analysis. They translate complex brain response patterns into actionable data which can be directly accessed by marketing teams, providing them with an accurate roadmap to maximize engagement and drive measurable conversion growth.
